import subprocess, sys, os

class GateGen:
    def __init__(self):

        self.lines = []
        self.const0 = None
        self.const1 = None

    def alloc(self, n=1):
        idx = self.next_idx
        self.next_idx += n
        return idx

    def reserve(self, idx):
        if idx >= self.next_idx:
            self.next_idx = idx + 1

    def copy(self, src, out_idx=None):
        if out_idx is None:
            out_idx = self.alloc()
        else:
            self.reserve(out_idx)
        self.lines.append(f"out{out_idx} = out{src}")
        return out_idx

    def const(self, v, out_idx=None):

            out_idx = self.alloc()
        else:

        self.lines.append(f"out{out_idx} = {v}")

    def not_(self, src, out_idx=None):

            out_idx = self.alloc()
        else:
            self.reserve(out_idx)
        self.lines.append(f"out{out_idx} = ~out{src}")

    def and_(self, s1, s2, out_idx=None):

        self.lines.append(f"out{out_idx} = out{s1} & out{s2}")

        else:
            self.reserve(out_idx)
        self.lines.append(f"out{out_idx} = out{s1} | out{s2}")

            out_idx = self.alloc()
        else:
            self.reserve(out_idx)
        self.lines.append(f"out{out_idx} = out{s1} ^ out{s2}")

    def mux(self, sel, s1, s2, not_sel=None):
        if not_sel is None:
            not_sel = self.not_(sel)
        t1 = self.and_(sel, s1)
        t2 = self.and_(not_sel, s2)
